text:
Situation: Isoflurane is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 100 bottles (12.3 days at 8.1 units per day), Corvale General holds 130 bottles (17 days at 7.7 units per day), and Corvale Lakeside holds 27 bottles (20 days at 1.4 units per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include isoflurane as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers 12 to 20 days across sites. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc. is the top-ranked purchasing option and is not on the shortage list. Its supply originates from Shandong New Time Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., which received a VAI inspection classification on 2024-07-09. Alternative manufacturers Halocarbon Life Sciences, LLC and Piramal Critical Care Inc. are also not on the shortage list, but their labels do not identify a specific manufacturing plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Mullan Pharmaceutical Inc. to replenish stock at all three sites; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Halocarbon Life Sciences, LLC as a secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Piramal Critical Care Inc. as a tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly and report changes at next P&T meeting; requires P&T Committee acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Direct purchase from Shandong New Time Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. due to lack of plant identification on label and no established purchasing agreement.
